title: Galkacyo Heat-Health Action Preparedness and Management Plan (HHAPMP) - Galkacyo, Somalia
organization: Ministry of Health & Human Services – Federal Government of Somalia, International Medical Corps
landscapes: Arid, Healthcare, Household, Institutional, Occupational, Urban
description: The Galkacyo Heat-Health Action Preparedness and Management Plan is a district-level, multi-sectoral initiative that addresses extreme heat through coordinated action across communities, health systems and local institutions. It focuses on strengthening heat-health governance, early warning and communication, health facility preparedness, community awareness and adaptive behavior, and climate-smart livelihoods and environmental management, with specific attention paid to internally displaced populations (IDPs) and other vulnerable groups. The plan was developed through a participatory, multi-stakeholder process and is intended to strengthen district- and facility-level capacity while supporting Somalia’s broader climate-health adaptation and resilience priorities.
